interface.shortDescription: Design, build, test, and export web data visualizations
interface.longDescription: Use Build Web Data Visualization to choose, design, implement, test, and export browser charts, dashboards, maps, WebGL/Three.js scenes, Canvas/D3 visuals, Gantt charts, UML/software diagrams, scrollytelling, reports, PDFs, and slide decks. It emphasizes source-backed data, accessible responsive layouts, URL-shareable analysis state, and concept-first design for advanced visual stories.
